stories.title: Mansur Yavaş'tan istifa kararının ardından ilk açıklama

en.title: First statement from Mansur Yavaş following resignation decision
en.summary: Ankara Metropolitan Municipality Mayor Mansur Yavaş's resignation from the CHP has drawn significant attention, with media reports speculating about his candidacy for the presidency.

en.title: Serious tunnel accident: 1 dead, 2 injured
en.summary: A collision involving a minivan and two trucks in the T-26 tunnel on the Artvin-Erzurum highway in Yusufeli district resulted in one Iranian truck driver's death and two injuries.

stories.title: Son dakika...Fon soruşturmasında 14 kişi daha tutuklandı

en.title: Breaking news... 14 more detained in fund investigation
en.summary: Of 20 suspects detained in a fund investigation, 14 were arrested while 3 were released under judicial supervision.

stories.title: Sermaye piyasası soruşturması... Emre Tezmen ve Alper Öztürk'ün ifadeleri ortaya çıktı

en.title: Capital markets investigation... Statements of Emre Tezmen and Alper Öztürk revealed
en.summary: Prosecutorial statements have emerged from detained Tera Investment Holding CEO Emre Tezmen and former Tera Portfolio General Manager Alper Öztürk in connection with a capital markets investigation.

stories.title: Borsa manipülasyonu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Tera patronu Emre Tezmen'in ifadesi ortaya çıktı! "Fon alımlardan haberim yok"

en.title: New development in stock market manipulation investigation: Tera boss Emre Tezmen's statement revealed! "I have no knowledge of fund purchases"
en.summary: Tera Group chairman Emre Tezmen, detained in a fund investigation by Istanbul prosecutors concerning thousands of citizens' losses, has made statements denying knowledge of fund purchases.

stories.title: Bahçeli'den Mansur Yavaş'ın istifası sonrası açıklama

en.title: Statement from Bahçeli following Mansur Yavaş's resignation
en.summary: MHP leader Devlet Bahçeli issued a statement after Ankara Metropolitan Municipality mayor Mansur Yavaş resigned from the CHP.

en.title: Chain-reaction accident in tunnel: 1 dead, 2 injured
en.summary: A multi-vehicle collision involving a truck and a pickup occurred in a tunnel in Yusufeli district of Artvin, resulting in one death and two injuries.

stories.title: Türkiye ve Irak'tan mutabakat: Çarpıcı 'Sincar' ayrıntısı

en.title: Agreement between Turkey and Iraq: Striking 'Sincar' detail
en.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan met with Iraqi Prime Minister Ali ez-Zeydi and agreed on establishing full state authority in Sincar and eliminating the presence of banned foreign armed groups.

stories.title: Bahçeli'den canlı yayında 'Mansur Yavaş' tepkisi: 'Çok önemli bir konu mu'

en.title: Bahçeli's live broadcast reaction to 'Mansur Yavaş': 'Is this a very important matter'
en.summary: MHP leader Devlet Bahçeli criticized coverage of Mansur Yavaş's resignation from the CHP, questioning whether the issue was overshadowing the president's United Nations General Assembly speech.

stories.title: Son dakika...Türkiye ile Irak arasında anlaşma: PKK Sincar'dan çıkarılacak

en.title: Agreement between Turkey and Iraq: PKK to be withdrawn from Sincar
en.summary: Turkey and Iraq have reached an agreement aimed at establishing full state authority in Sincar, according to a statement from the Communications Directorate.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: FETÖ'nün senaristi Bayram Özbek tutuklandı

en.title: New development in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation: FETÖ's screenwriter Bayram Özbek arrested
en.summary: Bayram Özbek, a screenwriter associated with FETÖ and the Kurtlar Vadisi television series, has been arrested as part of an investigation into the death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu.

stories.title: Doğu Perinçek 'Kozinoğlu soruşturması'nda ifade verdi: 1 şüpheli daha tutuklandı

en.title: Doğu Perinçek gives statement in 'Kozinoğlu investigation': 1 more suspect arrested
en.summary: Vatan Partisi leader Doğu Perinçek provided a statement in the Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation, and Bayram Özbek, a screenwriter of the Kurtlar Vadisi series, was arrested.

stories.title: BMGK'da yapay zeka alarmı: Şirket yöneticilerinden küresel düzenleme çağrısı

en.title: UN Security Council alarm on artificial intelligence: Call for global regulation from company executives
en.summary: The CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic addressed the UN Security Council about risks of artificial intelligence misuse and loss of control, calling for global collaboration and shared standards to ensure safe technology development.

stories.title: Erdoğan: İklim hedefleriyle kalkınma ve refah arasında güçlü bağ kurmalıyız

en.title: Erdoğan: We must establish strong links between climate targets and development and prosperity
en.summary: President Erdoğan stated that climate goals must align with social and economic realities, noting that countries cannot advance at the same pace while inequalities in financing and technology access persist.

en.title: 14 more suspects arrested in fund investigation
en.summary: Fourteen of twenty suspects detained in Istanbul regarding capital market transactions have been arrested as part of ongoing investigations.

stories.title: ROKETSAN KARAOK ilk kez hava hedefi vurdu

en.title: ROKETSAN KARAOK strikes air target for first time
en.summary: ROKETSAN announced the successful first strike of an air target by its KARAOK short-range anti-tank weapon system.

stories.title: ATSO Başkanı Yusuf Hacısüleyman: Belirsizlik iş dünyasının planlarını zorluyor

en.title: ATSO President Yusuf Hacısüleyman: Uncertainty Complicates Business Planning
en.summary: The president of ATSO stated that global developments, energy costs, and limited access to financing are pressuring businesses, requiring companies to reassess their product, market, cost, and investment strategies for the coming two years.
